quality_audit.readme_substance_rule: Each feature README must contain at least 200 non-whitespace characters. Feature identity is validated authoritatively across directory, manifest, contract, acceptance, traceability, and catalogs rather than by requiring a redundant prose token.
quality_audit.acceptance_nonempty_rule: Each feature package must contain at least one acceptance test with globally unique test_id.
quality_audit.traceability_nonempty_rule: Every required traceability category must be non-empty for feature packages.
quality_audit.declared_file_population_rule: Actual package files must equal the manifest declaration exactly.
quality_audit.strategy_rule: Prescribed strategies require an authoritative basis; partial-order edges must reference declared steps.
quality_audit.error_rule: Public error codes are unique per operation and source mappings remain explicit where source grammar differs.
quality_audit.runtime_rule: Low-level ownership, layout, allocation, serialization and concurrency remain unconstrained unless explicitly observable.
quality_audit.result: No cross-domain defect requiring scientific reinterpretation or package-semantic change was demonstrated. Two older catalog validation flags were normalized from pending to validated after their historical successful integration evidence.
